question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**present**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the popularity of newspapers in current society.
 
• The term chosen should reflect the current time period that aligns with the context of the passage.
 
• "**Present**" is appropriate as it refers to the current period, aligning with the context of newspapers being popular today.
 
• Other options ("**future**", "**dark**", "**past**") do not fit because they do not align with the context of current times in which newspapers are popular.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The newspaper is one of the significant signs of modern civilisation. It is the most popular form of reading in the present times because it interests all sorts of people. It is full of political news, sports and commercial news, as well as articles by well-known writers. A newspaper keeps us entertained and informed. In these days of democracy, public opinion rules everywhere. No government can long withstand the pressure of a strong public opinion. It is, therefore, quite clear that the press controls public opinion, and public opinion, in turn, controls the government. Ultimately, the press controls the government. It acts as an interpreter between the government and the people and brings the rulers and the ruled together.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Future (भविष्य): "Future" refers to a time period that has not yet occurred, which is not appropriate for the current popularity of newspapers.
 
• Dark (अंधकारमय): "Dark" refers to a lack of light or brightness, which does not fit the context of time periods mentioned in the passage.
 
• Past (अतीत): "Past" refers to time that has already occurred and is not suitable for discussing the current role and popularity of newspapers.
